clippy: macOS cargo clippy --locked -p transparent-shard-server --example rate-query -- -D warnings passed; Linux toolchain has no cargo-clippy component
deployment: SSH; load client/watchdog only; production server binaries unchanged
rate_definition: Target 5 encrypted POST attempts per second, fresh key per attempt. Connection interruptions can retry at most three total attempts; retries consume scheduled slots rather than exceeding the rate. Setup and operator probes are separate.
workload: New selections: 40% recent directory, 40% recent pages, 10% archive directory, 10% archive pages across 85 sealed shards / 5440 fixture rows. Transport retries retain the original target and use scheduled slots.
control: An enabled systemd service runs indefinitely. Missing/denied/>45-second-old permit blocks query admission. Health sampling about every 15 seconds; sustained noncritical failure pauses and recovers after two healthy samples. OOM/restarts/memory below 15%, disk below 10%, changed worker binary or correctness failure latch until investigation. A correctness failure terminates query generation immediately.
